title: Pricing the Food and Beverage on a Delivered Event
content:
What the food and beverage on a Private Event & Banquet Services final bill is priced on is settled by the guest count the event was actually served to against the count the guarantee confirmed, at the per-guest value the guarantee priced to, which is the value the guarantee entry carries divided by the count it guarantees.

## The three cases

1. Where the guests served passed the count the guarantee confirmed, the food and beverage the bill is priced on is every guest served at that per-guest value.
2. Where the guests served fell short of the count the guarantee confirmed, the food and beverage the bill is priced on is the guaranteed count at the per-guest value the guarantee priced to, the shortfall itself being dealt with when the bill is settled rather than when it is raised.
3. Where the guests served match the count the guarantee confirmed, or no delivered entry stands for the booking, the food and beverage the bill is priced on is the value actually consumed as the delivered entry records it.

| Guests served against the count the guarantee confirmed | Priced on |
| --- | --- |
| More | Every guest served at the per-guest value |
| Fewer | The guaranteed count at the per-guest value |
| The same | The value actually consumed as the delivered entry records it |
| No delivered entry stands | The value actually consumed as the delivered entry records it |

## Worked illustrations on hypothetical records

A guarantee entry carries a value of 24000 against a guaranteed count of 200, so the per-guest value is 120. Where 214 guests were served, the food and beverage is priced at 214 times 120, that is 25680. Where 186 guests were served, it is priced at 200 times 120, that is 24000. Where exactly 200 were served, it is priced at the value the delivered entry records as actually consumed, whatever that figure is.

The per-guest value is always the guarantee's own: the value the guarantee entry carries divided by the count it guarantees, never the delivered value divided by the guests served.
